vacuity: every status is allowed (bump's overflow and limit reverts are results the source gives), and no witness that the postcondition rejects a result is in the statement
spec: a Lean specification (Verify.LoopSource.MirLink.BumpPost), not solar-verify's export: a successful bump(a) leaves slot 0 holding the old count plus a, at most limit (slot 1), and every other slot as it was
excluded: calls: bump(a) with a ≤ K for an iteration bound K ≤ 13042098468400, no value, any storage; the other functions and other call data are outside the statement
gas: the bound is K * 1414400 + 3536012; below it the bytecode may run out of gas, which equivalence admits as a failure that changes nothing
deployment: the init code is not covered by this statement
source model trusted: SolidCore's checked Counter (Contracts.VerifyCounter.Source.contract?) is the meaning of Counter.sol (frontend trust boundary)
